title: "OpenBloom": A Question-Based LLM Tool to Support Stigma Reduction in Reproductive Well-Being

bias_targets.methodology: User surveys rating the cultural sensitivity of AI-generated reproductive health questions, combined with qualitative interviews and focus groups discussing cultural appropriateness, historical contextualization, and Western-centric assumptions.

Qualitative evaluation via interviews and focus groups assessing the inclusivity of AI-generated questions regarding diverse gender identities, pronoun usage, and the inclusion of men in reproductive health discourse.
Qualitative feedback from focus groups evaluating whether AI-generated scenarios explicitly include LGBTQ+ individuals and avoid heteronormative assumptions.
Qualitative assessment through focus groups noting the omission and erasure of disabled individuals in AI-generated reproductive health education content.
